task: 00035 - Herdr live terminals + websocket Command Center

nodes.title: Map today's Command Center terminal, stream and task-state surfaces
steps: Trace /api/tasks/{id}/terminal: SSE of `herdr pane read --source recent` text, sanitized, read-only, 4-stream cap.
Trace /api/stream: SSE snapshots driven by DashboardPoller.wait_for_update with 15 s heartbeats; the frontend polls through useDashboard.
Trace _DashboardGuards: GET-only, exact loopback Host, CSP connect-src 'self'; any websocket must pass an equivalent guard.
Trace tasks.json writers: locked_tasks + _write_locked in status_file.py; herdr_launch records herdr_pane; drive rows.py imports the herdr-default worktree.
Record the herdr 0.9.5 socket API surface we can use: pane.read (ansi, visible), pane.send_input/send_text/send_keys, events.subscribe with pane_output_changed/pane_exited.

nodes.title: Interactive per-task terminal over a token-gated localhost websocket
steps: Add /ws/tasks/{id}/terminal: resolves the task's herdr_pane, streams `visible` ANSI frames on pane_output_changed (poll fallback) to the client.
Client input (xterm.js onData) is sent as pane.send_input text/keys; resize is advisory only (Herdr owns geometry).
Gate attach with a per-server-session token minted at startup, delivered only to same-origin pages, checked on the websocket handshake with Origin + Host loopback checks.
Read-only switch: server flag --terminal-readonly and a per-connection mode; read-only connections never forward input.
Embed xterm.js (@xterm/xterm, bundled, no CDN) in TaskDetail's TerminalPanel with attach/detach, read-only toggle and status badges.

nodes.title: Live event websocket replacing snapshot polling
steps: Add /ws/events: on connect send the full snapshot, then typed deltas: task_changed, task_finished, waiting_added, waiting_cleared, stale_changed, heartbeat.
Diff successive poller snapshots server-side to derive the deltas; a tasks.json mtime watcher wakes the poller immediately instead of waiting the poll interval.
Frontend useDashboard switches to the websocket with exponential backoff reconnect (1 s to 30 s, jitter) and falls back to /api/stream SSE after repeated failures.
Keep /api/snapshot and /api/stream working unchanged for the legacy page and as the fallback path.

nodes.title: Dashboard as source of truth: heartbeats, stale detector, reconciler
steps: Add heartbeat(path, task_id, state=None, note=None, pid=None) helper writing last_heartbeat_at through locked_tasks + _write_locked.
Stale detector: a working task is stale when its pid is dead, its herdr pane is gone or has exited, or no heartbeat/activity for N minutes (default 20, configurable).
Surface stale (reason + since) in the snapshot and UI badges without silently rewriting state.

Reconciler CLI (python -m omega_prime.dashboard.reconcile) rebuilds herdr_pane/pid liveness from `herdr pane list` + process-info and /proc, marks rows stale or attaches orphan panes by workspace label; dry-run by default, --apply writes through the locked helpers.
Make status_file validation tolerant of the new optional fields (last_heartbeat_at, pid, stale) so older writers keep working.

nodes.title: Security, redaction and migration risks
steps: Interactive input means remote code execution on the box: never bind beyond loopback, reject non-loopback Origin/Host, require the token, cap connections.
Output redaction: interactive frames are raw ANSI; apply the token/secret redaction to frames before sending while keeping escape sequences intact.
Cross-site websocket hijacking: browsers do not apply CORS to websockets, so Origin must be checked explicitly and the token must not live in a cookie readable cross-site.
Stale detection must not flip tasks owned by other workers; the reconciler is dry-run unless --apply and never deletes rows.
Open questions: none (defaults: token in a same-origin meta/bootstrap endpoint, read-only default off for Ove, stale N=20 min).

nodes.title: Build plan, migration and verification
steps: Wave 1 (file-disjoint): 115-01 heartbeat+stale+reconciler (status_file, new stale.py/reconcile.py, model fields); 115-02 herdr websocket bridge + token + /ws routes (new terminal_ws.py, app.py).
Wave 2: 115-03 /ws/events delta bus + poller wake; 115-04 frontend xterm.js TerminalPanel + websocket useDashboard with backoff + SSE fallback, rebuild static/cc.
Tests: websocket events, attach + token/Origin auth, read-only mode, stale detector, reconciler, redaction of frames; served checks on 127.0.0.1:7441 only.
Migration: inventory working tasks/processes, move non-Herdr runners into Herdr panes (sandbox via drive pattern when they build code), record herdr_pane.
Ship: push feat/herdr-ws, draft PR on top of #59, Greptile loop to 5/5; 7421 swap stays an ask for Ove.
